sections.4.1 Penalty: A penalty of 1% on the applicable interest rate applies when a fixed deposit (FD) is withdrawn before maturity.
sections.4.2 Senior citizen waiver: For senior citizens holding an FD under the Sanchay scheme, the premature withdrawal penalty is waived for tenures above 12 months.
sections.4.3 Approvals: Branch managers may approve premature withdrawal exceptions up to INR 5,00,000. Amounts above this require regional head approval.

sections.4.1 Penalty: A penalty of 0.5% on the applicable interest rate applies when a fixed deposit is withdrawn before maturity.
sections.4.2 Senior citizen waiver: No waiver applies to senior citizens.

sections.3.2 Counter withdrawal limit: The cash withdrawal limit at the branch counter is INR 2,00,000 per customer per day. Withdrawals above this require 24 hours' notice.
sections.3.4 Cash transaction reporting: Cash transactions of INR 10,00,000 or more in a month must be flagged to the compliance team for CTR reporting.

sections.2.1 Annual leave: Employees accrue 24 days of privileged leave (PL) per calendar year. Up to 60 days of PL may be carried forward.
sections.2.3 Work from home: Head-office staff may work from home up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Branch staff are not eligible for WFH.

sections.1.1 Director band: Director-level fixed pay ranges from INR 85 lakh to INR 1.4 crore. Variable pay is capped at 40% of fixed pay.
sections.1.2 Confidentiality: This document is restricted to HR leadership and executive committee members.

sections.5.1 LTV caps: Maximum loan-to-value (LTV) is 90% for loans up to INR 30 lakh, 80% for loans between INR 30 lakh and 75 lakh, and 75% above INR 75 lakh.
sections.5.3 FOIR: Fixed obligation to income ratio (FOIR) must not exceed 55% for salaried applicants and 50% for self-employed applicants.
sections.5.6 Exceptions: Credit exceptions above policy require approval from the zonal credit committee and must be recorded in the LOS.

sections.2.1 Officially valid documents: Accepted proof of identity includes passport, Aadhaar (with consent), voter ID, driving licence and NREGA job card. PAN is mandatory for account opening.
sections.3.2 Re-KYC periodicity: Re-KYC is required every 2 years for high-risk customers, every 8 years for medium-risk and every 10 years for low-risk customers.
sections.4.1 Video KYC: Video-based customer identification (V-CIP) is permitted when conducted by trained staff from bank premises with live location capture.

sections.1.2 Alert SLA: Transaction monitoring alerts must be reviewed by an analyst within 7 calendar days of generation.
sections.1.4 STR filing: Suspicious transaction reports (STRs) must be filed within 7 days of the analyst concluding that a transaction is suspicious.
sections.2.1 Tipping off: Staff must never disclose to a customer that an STR has been filed or is being considered.

sections.1.1 Approved tools: Only bank-approved AI assistants accessed through the bank's AI gateway may be used for work. Public consumer chatbots are prohibited for bank data.
sections.1.3 Customer data: Customer personal data must never be pasted into an AI tool unless the tool is approved for confidential data and the purpose is documented.
sections.2.1 Human review: AI-generated content sent to customers must be reviewed by a human before sending.

sections.2.1 Dispute window: Customers may raise a debit card dispute within 90 days of the transaction date.
sections.2.4 Shadow credit: For disputes under INR 25,000, a provisional (shadow) credit is given within 10 working days while the chargeback is investigated.

sections.3.1 Turnover method: Working capital limits for MSME borrowers with turnover up to INR 5 crore are assessed at 20% of projected annual turnover.
sections.3.3 Review: All working capital limits must be reviewed annually; stock statements are required monthly for limits above INR 1 crore.

sections.1.1 Fee: Northwind US charges an overdraft fee of USD 15, limited to one fee per day. No fee applies when the overdraft is USD 50 or less.
sections.1.2 Residency: US customer data is processed only in US-region systems.
